newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Hebron transfer set for Friday - PLO official.
newsitem.headline: Hebron transfer set for Friday - PLO official.

text.p: Israel will begin handing over most of Hebron to Palestinian rule on Friday morning, Palestinian security chief Jibril Rajoub said.

"The redeployment will begin at 8 o'clock (0600 GMT) and also the celebrations," he told reporters after emerging from a brief visit to the Israeli military headquarters atop a hill in central Hebron.
"All the arrangements are ready for the redeployment," he said.
Israeli soldiers spent most of Thursday dismantling checkpoints and bases in Hebron in advance of their withdrawal from 80 percent of the city.
The Israeli parliament approved an agreement with the Palestine Liberation Organisation (PLO) on Thursday night, paving the way for the pullback, which is expected to be swift.
